item.title: Hikma Skinny Label Case
item.description:
• Summary: The Supreme Court unanimously sided with Hikma in its skinny label case against Amarin, a significant legal victory for generic manufacturers. The ruling allows Hikma to market a generic version of Vascepa with a label that carves out patented indications. Additionally, Hikma announced it will funnel $267 million into Ohio operations, while Cingulate received a CRL for its ADHD drug.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, STAT News, Endpoints News, Endpoints News

item.title: Alnylam-Inceptive AI Partnership
item.description:
• Summary: Alnylam has partnered with AI pioneer Inceptive to transform siRNA design, paying $30 million upfront with potential milestone payments up to $2 billion. The deal aims to leverage Inceptive's AI platform to enhance the discovery and development of RNAi therapeutics.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, BioSpace, Fierce Biotech

item.title: Parabilis Medicines IPO
item.description:
• Summary: Peptide biotech Parabilis Medicines is preparing for an IPO targeting up to $476 million to fund its Phase 3 desmoid tumor drug. The company aims to advance its pipeline of peptide-based therapeutics, with the lead candidate showing promise in desmoid tumors.
  • MoAs: Gamma-secretase inhibitor targeting the Notch pathway (AL102), disrupting tumor growth in desmoid tumors.
  • Sources: BioSpace, Fierce Biotech, Endpoints News

item.title: Regeneron-Cytomx Partnership
item.description:
• Summary: Regeneron has expanded its relationship with Cytomx in a deal valued at up to $2 billion, adding eight new targets for cancer therapy. The collaboration will leverage Cytomx's Probody therapeutic platform to create conditionally activated antibodies for oncology.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace, Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Axsome Sunosi Patent
item.description:
• Summary: Axsome Therapeutics has successfully defended its patent for Sunosi (solriamfetol), a wakefulness-promoting agent for narcolepsy and obstructive sleep apnea, through 2040. The company fended off generic competition, ensuring market exclusivity for its blockbuster drug. Sunosi is a dual dopamine and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor.
  • MoAs: Dopamine and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (DNRI).
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Eli Lilly Ascidian Partnership
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly has entered into a partnership with Ascidian Therapeutics worth up to $1.9 billion to develop genetic medicines. The collaboration will leverage Ascidian's RNA exon editing platform to create therapies for a range of diseases. The deal includes an upfront payment and milestones.
  • MoAs: N/A (partnership-level news; no specific drug mechanism mentioned).
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Dimension Life Sciences Fund
item.description:
• Summary: Dimension Life Sciences is seeking up to $750 million for its third life sciences fund, following a string of successful investments. The fund will focus on early-stage biotechnology and life sciences companies, providing capital for drug development and innovation.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News
